Name: Fabulous Elliott - Seasonal Portraits
Author: BasfulVixen
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4][center]Want Elliott to keep his fabio-esque appeal?
Hate the inconsistency of his original portrait angle?
Want him to look both fabulous and just shy of absolute Camp ?
﻿Then this is the portrait mod for you!

Featuring both seasonal and festival portraits, along with the corresponding in-game sprites.
Mod away to jazz our beloved poet up.

﻿[/center][/size][/font][size=3][font=Georgia]This mod consists of a redone portrait of Elliott with seasonal outfits, along with 8 festival outfits.[/font]

[font=Times New Roman]~*~OUTFITS~*~[/font]
[/size]* Including optional Mermaid Pendant after marriage earring versions - based on [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/KeyholderOfStories/]KeyholderOfStories [/url]'s lovely [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/1f9lgbp/comment/llr5k18/?context=3]rendition [/url]*

[list]
[*]Spring: A cream pirate shirt and a vivid burgundy vest
[*]Summer: A bright blue button up with a cream u-neck waist coat
[*]Fall: His quintessential red tailcoat jacket
[*]Winter: His original trench coat and scarf
[*]Beach: His original green wetsuit pants, with a hair ribbon
[/list]
[list]
[*]Egg Fest: A high collared gauzy shirt topped with a cream corset vest. Accessorized with gold egg jewelry.
[*]Flower Dance : A two piece suit accentuated with a blue rose neck corsages and hair piece.
[*]Luau: A shimmery sea green shirt with a gold collar chain and starfish earrings.
[*]Moonlit Jelly: A sateen midnight blue shirt with a silvery gray vest and silver collar chains.
[*]Stardew Fair: A cherry red shirt with a silhouette defining white waist coat, topped off with a bright green bowtie.
[*]Spirits Eve: A green V-neck accessorized with a pearl beaded fish net. Dark green fish finned ears make the costume.
[*]Ice Fest: A cozy ice blue turtle neck under a soft gray sweater, accompanied by a pair of earmuffs.
[*]Winter Star: An emerald green wide sleeved cloak and vivid red scarf.
[/list]
[font=Georgia][size=3]Misc[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][size=2]Warm weather and cold weather pajamas (sleeping)[/size]
[/list]
~*~﻿[font=Times New Roman][size=3]FUTURE UPDATES~*~[/size][/font]

Indoor clothes! I.E - farmhouse pajamas
Sleepy Mornings
Maybe a flustered or saucy portrait
Optional Chest Hair alt.
Any other things I can think of
[font=Times New Roman][size=3]
~*~INSTALLATION~*~[/size][/font]

Download Manually
Extract ZIP Folder﻿ into Stardew Valley mods folder

REQUIRES Content Patcher 2.3.0 and Smapi to work


Compatible with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic

Thanks to the Stardew valley discord for coding help! <3
